New hire training · Page 1 of 4

Welcome to Bonefish Grill!

You're training as a server here. Bartender training is coming later. This is where you learn how we do things and what makes a good Angler.

🚪 You start outside. Just walk in through the front door at the bottom and we'll take it from there.

Flip through these pages real quick. I'll walk you through the training options, the controls, and a couple of things worth knowing before your first ticket.

Choosing a track · Page 2 of 4

Pick your training at the PCs

Walk up to a ring and stay put for a sec. When it fills up, you're in.

🖥️
Stand in the ring for 2 secondsThe PCs are down in the lower-left corner, against the bottom wall just left of the front door. Step in and the ring turns gold. Step out and it starts over.
🎫
Table TrainingYou'll run trays and learn the floor as you go, table numbers and all.
🍽️
Menu TrainingSame idea, but you're learning the menu while you run trays. Once you're in, a menu lets you pick Everything together or Drinks only, then a pop-up walks you through the rest.
📱
Tablet SimThe POS tablet itself, all 35 pages in a window over the floor. Flip through the tabs and learn where every button lives.

You won't see an exit ring here in the hub. You're not in a training run yet.

Controls · Page 3 of 4

Moving & running trays

Grab it at the expo, carry it over, walk into the table. That's a delivery.

⌨️
ComputerUse WASD or the arrow keys. The D-pad on screen works too.
🕹️
PhoneDrag the joystick. Push it further and you'll walk faster. Want it on the other side? Tap Hand L / R up top.
🔔
Pick up at the expoWhen the bell rings, head in through the IN door on the right. The OUT door only goes one way, out.
🍽️
DeliverYour tray tells you the table number. Just walk right into that table. You'll pop back to the expo on your own after.
🚪
Leave a trackStand in the little coral EXIT ring by the OUT door for 2 seconds. Or just tap Exit, or hit Esc.
Good to know · Page 4 of 4

Before you start

💡
HintIt's up in the top bar. Turn it on and your table glows, plus the numbers show on every table while you're learning.
🔔
Sound & MusicThe music plays the whole time, in the lobby, on the floor, even over pop-ups. You can turn it off anytime up top.
💾
Progress savesIt saves by itself, right on this device. Close it and come back later, you'll pick up right where you left off.
📖
This bookletNeed to check something again? Tap Guide up top and it'll open right back up.
📋
What's newTap Patch notes up top anytime to see everything that's changed, newest first.

Ready? Head in the front door: the PCs are right there on your left, in the lower-left corner. You got this.
